part.text: {"scores":[{"programme":1,"criterion":"fit","value":5,"reason":"Card directly measures AIFS-ENS extreme-event skill versus member count, the quantity operational sizing depends on."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"change","value":5,"reason":"Either outcome changes operational choice: scale AIFS-ENS members for extremes or confirm saturation and redirect uncertainty work."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"new","value":5,"reason":"Supported practice says ECMWF has not assessed AIFS-CRPS extreme-event skill beyond the 50-member baseline."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"Card tests tail-sampling scaling, but on AIFS-ENS, a stand-in for HENS's SFNO bred-vector/checkpoint system."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Outcome could simplify HENS if transferred to SFNO; that bridge is not done, so change needs further work."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"new","value":3,"reason":"HENS already measured tail-information gain versus member count for SFNO-BVMC, not for AIFS-ENS exchangeable draws."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"Its step is stated only in card terms; AIFS-ENS runtime/scoring is a stand-in use of Anemoi tooling."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Outcome might add Anemoi documentation/config guidance, but this requires work and is not a current operational decision."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"new","value":5,"reason":"Supported claims say Anemoi has not published a 10–1,000-member AIFS-ENS extreme-tail saturation study."}]}
